result.title: Maple Row remediation, records and hold desks
result.text: The landlord-funded evidence chain is requested through the remediation request desk (remediation_request_desk) below. Its signed reports - repair, drying, then the independent retest - are never pushed: they are pulled from the remediation records desk (remediation_records_desk) once each report exists, in order. Listings and condition records come from the property records service (rental_records_search). Once a unit's full report chain is complete, an approved no-deposit hold is placed through the unit hold desk (unit_hold_desk), naming one current cleared listing row; holds require the tenant's approval of the exact plan and take no deposit.
result.snippet: Maple Row desks: remediation requests, signed report records, and no-deposit holds.
